Each accent arrow points from a node back to the parent it was discovered from, and numbered badges give the discovery order. The card maps B to A, C to A, and D to C." width="100%"} The breadth-first search tree from `source` gives each reached node a parent: the node it was discovered from, one hop closer to the source. This dictionary is that tree, child to parent, from which any shortest (fewest-hops) path back to the source can be read. It is the compact form of `bfs_tree()` and `bfs_edges()`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The start node, as an ID or label. [depth_limit]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional maximum depth. [mode]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["out"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Edge direction to follow on directed graphs: `"out"` (default), `"in"` or `"all"`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Child node ID to parent node ID, in discovery order (the source is not a key). ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the source does not exist or `mode` is invalid. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Read off the tree edges of `bfs_edges()`, $O(V + E)$. Matches NetworkX's `bfs_predecessors`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#3b66726b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph().add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) g.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C"), ("C", "D")]) {g.get_label_from_id(c): g.get_label_from_id(p) for c, p in g.bfs_predecessors("A").items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'B': 'A', 'C': 'A', 'D': 'C'} ``` ::: :::
